name: b6406-tasbih
prompt: Cinematic vertical 9:16 photoreal, 7th-century Arabia, a bright clean room with whitewashed mud-brick walls and soft even daylight. Close shot of one anonymous RIGHT hand holding a string of wooden prayer beads (a misbaha of round brown beads with a small tassel): the beads loop over the fingers and the thumb is pulling one bead down. The hand rests on the thigh of a man sitting on his folded legs on a woven palm-fibre prayer mat, as in the sitting of prayer - not cross-legged. Exactly five fingers, natural proportions. Only the right hand, forearm and thigh in a plain white cotton garment are visible - no face, no head, no left hand, no feet. No window, no door and no sun in frame. Warm, calm, vibrant colours, no modern objects.
